HEROS.title: HEROS

HEROS.metric: MCP 2025-11-25 runtime · 19 MCP tests · macOS/Linux/Windows CI

HEROS-Firewall.title: HEROS Firewall
HEROS-Firewall.plain: A security guard between an AI agent and its tools that blocks dangerous calls before they run.
HEROS-Firewall.metric: 1,000 attack payloads blocked · 0 false positives · p99 0.10 ms

HEROS-Cloud-SaaS.title: HEROS Cloud
HEROS-Cloud-SaaS.plain: A workflow studio where the AI writes plain-English safety rules from its own failures, and a human approves them.

RouteLLM-Gateway.title: RouteLLM Gateway
RouteLLM-Gateway.plain: Sends easy prompts to a cheap model and hard ones to a frontier model, so you pay less for the same answers.

llm-control-plane.title: LLM Control Plane
llm-control-plane.plain: One gateway in front of every LLM provider, with failover, rate limits, cost tracking and an audit log.

GraphRAG-CodeAudit.title: GraphRAG CodeAudit
GraphRAG-CodeAudit.plain: Turns a codebase into a knowledge graph so an AI can answer big-picture audit questions, not just keyword lookups.
GraphRAG-CodeAudit.metric: Beats flat RAG on 64 of 100 questions (deterministic rubric)

HEROS-RL.title: HEROS-RL

Reflexion-SWE.title: Reflexion-SWE

rlvr-bias-probe.title: RLVR Bias Probe
